title.narrative: 2023-25 Bolivia: Journalism and freedom of expression

description.narrative:
By the end of the intervention, it is expected that the at least 80 journalists who will be benefiting from the planned activities under this contribution will i) better know their rights and obligations within the framework of the legislation that protects freedom of expression, and ii) acquire skills to help them improve their physical, legal, digital, and psychoemotional security. In the end, the final goal is to achieve better and safer practices of journalism in Bolivia.
Other objectives by the end of the initiative are to have at least ten publications on topics such as: freedom of expression, human rights and the work of journalism in democracy and at least eight bulletins with information related to the present initiative are disseminated.
Att förbättra förutsättningarna för journalister att utöva djupgående journalistik fri från hot och censur
To improve conditions for journalists to practice in-depth journalism free from threats and censorships

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative:
By the end of the intervention, it is expected that the at least 80 journalists who will be benefiting from the planned activities under this contribution will i) better know their rights and obligations within the framework of the legislation that protects freedom of expression, and ii) acquire skills to help them improve their physical, legal, digital, and psychoemotional security. In the end, the final goal is to achieve better and safer practices of journalism in Bolivia.
Other objectives by the end of the initiative are to have at least ten publications on topics such as: freedom of expression, human rights and the work of journalism in democracy and at least eight bulletins with information related to the present initiative are disseminated. ACHIEVED RESULTS Journalists from all over Bolivia have been able to integrate, form a network and become aware of the importance of journalism for democracy, human rights and the development of a nation. The journalists took on an active and participatory role in the defense of the profession by promoting projects that required them not only to be familiar with human rights issues, but also to think critically and creatively in order to propose solutions to the major obstacles and dangers facing journalism and the independent media. 55 committed journalists, with projects as diverse as the creation of a network of rural journalists and a website to denounce public officials who abuse their power, hide information and encourage corruption. After a rigorous evaluation process, the Universidad Nuestra Senora de La Paz received the ministerial resolution to develop the diploma course. The journalistic community was strengthened by creating a space for the exchange of knowledge and experiences.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
